body:
Good morning!

The new book is bound and wrapped in cloth. It's ready to go to Bellhaven, and I'd like you to carry it.

Come to the scriptorium, and I'll show you the way on the map.
summary: Carry the new book toward Bellhaven.
done: The book is on its way!

tasks.where: in the scriptorium at the monastery (walk the road, or take the map)
